title: Fractal Cybernetic Entity
description: A highly detailed robotic humanoid figure stands centered in a dark digital void, its body composed of sharp black and silver geometric facets. The figure's right hand is raised with palm open while its left hand is positioned near its chest, both hands and torso emitting glowing white particles and energy effects.
prompt: A powerful humanoid robot made of sharp black crystalline geometric facets and polished silver armor stands in a dark futuristic chamber with circuit patterns on the walls. Its head has glowing white eyes creating a lens flare. The figure's right hand is raised with palm facing forward, left hand positioned near its torso, both hands and body surrounded by glowing white particles and energy shards floating in the air.
